title: Veritas deploy weekly standup scratch (Rhea Kapoor)
content:
Purpose: prep notes for Friday standup with Veritas (customer). Personal scratchpad: agenda, blockers, owners, and follow-ups. Keep short — this will be expanded during call.

Attendees (expected): Rhea (me), Tom (site-eng), Lina (infra eng), Marcus (customer PM - Veritas), Claire (Redwood SRE), Sana (security reviewer - optional)

High level goal for this week:
- get network path verification + DB connectivity validated in prod-like VPC (must have before cutover window)
- unblock storage mount race condition seen in staging after kernel bump
- confirm HA plan for Redis replica failovers during maintenance window

Agenda (15–20m):
1) Quick status round (2m each)
2) Network validation results & next steps (5m) — owner: Tom
3) Storage mount blocker recap + mitigation plan (5m) — owner: Lina
4) Maintenance window proposal & final checklist (3m) — owner: Rhea/Marcus
5) Open questions / parking lot (2m)

Milestones / dates to surface: (call-out during sync)
- Network validation window: target by 2026-03-15 (end-to-end reachability + iptables baseline)
- Storage driver patch roll to staging: 2026-03-09 (done) -> prod canary: 2026-03-13
- Cutover (final switch) earliest: 2026-03-20 pending green checks

Current blockers (short):
- PRIVATE: intermittent failure mounting NFS on nodes after kernel 5.18.2 (seen on staging). Root cause suspected race in systemd mount ordering.
  - Impact: prevents safe scaling of inference workers (cold starts fail)
  - Owner: Lina Hart
  - Mitigation under test: systemd override + mount retries (test id: PRJ-4123-attach-retry). Need logs from 3 failed nodes (ask Claire).

- Network ACL asymmetry between prod VPC and Veritas peering config (tcp 9200 allowed but ephemeral range blocked).
  - Impact: KV cache syncs intermittently drop -> increased latencies and token loss for in-flight requests.
  - Owner: Tom Nguyen / Marcus to push change on their side in VPC console
  - Next step: Confirm ephemeral ports range allowed by 2026-03-10. If not, escalate to NetOps (SLA 24h).

- Redis replica promotion flaky under failover injection (observed zl-redis-2 flapping).
  - Impact: potential 2–5s request spikes during promotion (acceptable short-term but needs remediation).
  - Owner: Rhea (coordinate SRE + Redis team), Marcus to prioritize during maintenance window.
  - Action: Run planned failover test in staging on 2026-03-11 (post-tests: collect p99 latency).

Decisions to confirm on call:
- Do we proceed with kernel patch to prod canary on 2026-03-13 if staging shows <2% mount-fail rate? (I will propose yes with rollback plan).
- Maintenance window timeline: prefer 03-20 02:00–05:00 UTC (low traffic). Marcus to confirm no internal conflicts.

Action items (clear and short):
- Lina: collect full systemd logs from nodes node-03,node-07,node-12 and drop in PRJ-4123 ticket by EOD 2026-03-12.
- Tom: confirm ephemeral port range allowed in Veritas peering and post screenshot to the thread by 2026-03-11.
- Claire (SRE): stand up ephemeral canary cluster for kernel 5.18.2 and run mount stress for 6 hours; report pass/fail by 2026-03-12.
- Marcus (customer): confirm maintenance window date 03-20 or propose alternate by 2026-03-12.
- Rhea (me): prepare rollback docs and a runbook snippet for the kernel canary (draft by 2026-03-12 AM).

Notes-to-self (script snippets / interview points):
- When asking Marcus about VPC ACLs, request both console screenshot + VPC peering CIDR list (avoid back-and-forth).
- For mount failure logs, look for: "mount.nfs: mount system call failed: Connection refused" vs permission errors (different mitigation).
- Verify kernel-specific modules: nfs, nfsd, rpcbind versions in staging.

Parking lot / non-blocking items to follow up later:
- encryption-at-rest key rotation schedule for Veritas (security asked about this but not blocking). Owner: Sana (follow Q2).
- Evaluate using diskless cold starts to mitigate mount race (research spike: 2d). Owner: Lina

Open questions to raise: 
- Is Veritas comfortable with a 5–10 minute degraded window during Redis replica promotion tests? Marcus to confirm.
- Should we add a second NAT gateway in the peered VPC to reduce ephemeral port contention? (cost tradeoff).

Quick comms notes (for post-call):
- If we get green on staging canary, email the Veritas infra distribution with decision + runbook + rollback steps.
- If staging fails, schedule triage + RCA the following day with kernel vendor if needed.

End-of-day checklist (for me):
- send calendar invite update with final agenda (15m) and attach runbook draft
- update PRJ-4123 with Claire's test result and link to canary logs
- note to hand off to on-call if maintenance starts off-hours

——
Raw thought fragments (scratch):
- consider prefacing meeting w/ one-line status email so call can be shorter (helps Marcus).
- keep maintenance window under 4h max; if extra steps needed split into two nights.
- remember to ask if Veritas wants an exec summary post-cutover (they've requested in prior projects).

End.
